briefings.title: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on Media, Politics, and Power | The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: Amjad Masad argues that for ambitious startups, "memeing a dream into reality" through founder-led storytelling is a survival requirement for attracting talent and capital before a product finds commercial success.

briefings.title: Private Markets and The Future of Capital Allocation with Marc Rowan | The a16z Show

people.name: Marc Rowan
people.role: Cofounder, CEO, and Chair of Apollo Global Management

briefings.tldr: As public markets face extreme concentration, Apollo Global Management is scaling past $1 trillion in assets by shifting from traditional private equity to investment-grade private credit—bridging long-term retirement liabilities with the massive, capital-intensive infrastructure demands of AI, energy, and robotics.

briefings.title: The Investor Behind Costco, Starbucks, and Blackstone | Tony James on The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: Wall Street legend Tony James outlines the strategic decisions that drove historic growth at DLJ, Costco, and Blackstone, emphasizing how rigorous investment committee debate, aggressive retail distribution, and disciplined succession planning build enduring financial franchises.

briefings.title: Marc Andreessen on how the internet changed news, politics, and outrage | The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: The internet has reinvented the 24-hour news cycle into "Randommonium"—a relentless 2.5-day viral outrage loop—which, while socially exhausting, may be effectively shunting historically high levels of physical political violence into purely rhetorical virtual combat.

briefings.title: The Era of AI Agents | Aaron Levie on The a16z Show
briefings.tldr: As AI agents increasingly outnumber human users, enterprise software must pivot from GUI-first to API/CLI-first architectures, though this transition faces significant hurdles in security, "system of record" stability, and a massive underestimation of future compute economics.
